files.html: //! robotgpu_lab - THE SIMULATOR'S CHECKS, IN A PAGE: Geno's worlds stepped on the GPU and on the CPU twin side by side, //! MuJoCo's humanoid's worlds solved against their joint limits on both - the constraint program, its rows and Newton //! - and each check shown as agreeing or not. The same page runs on WebGPU in a browser and on Vulkan natively. //! //! The checks run as the simulator always does: nothing waits for the GPU. One step is submitted on both Sims, what //! each check compares is requested from both, and every frame the page collects whatever has arrived: //! //! first frame both Sims: `world_u` filled with a poison word, every world posed in its own way, a step //! submitted; the overflow words and every pose array requested //! later frames the twin's arrays collected at once; the device's once their copies have finished //! then, per check the two compared - every world's overflow word zero on both (the step cleared it); every //! pose within a few epsilons (the device's sine, cosine and square root differ from the CPU's //! in the last bits); the constraint program's rows, their integers exactly, and Newton's answer //! within its bars (`robotgpu_host.ConstraintComparison`) const std = @import("std"); const z = @import("zimr"); const zm = @import("zm"); const robotgpu = @import("robotgpu"); const robotgpu_host = @import("robotgpu_host"); const Allocator = std.mem.Allocator; const eql = std.mem.eql; const Color = zm.Color; const Sim = robotgpu_host.Sim; const Pipe = robotgpu_host.Pipe; const atkinson_mono_ttf = @embedFile("atkinson_mono_ttf"); /// The kernels as this build embeds them: WGSL in a browser, SPIR-V natively. /// The lab's settings. const Settings = struct { /// Worlds in each Sim - Geno's 64 fit the tests' arena sizes. world_count: u32 = 64, /// The word `world_u` is filled with before the step, so a word the step did not write stands out. poison: u32 = 0xdead_beef, /// How far a world's pose moves each coordinate from the reference pose, per world and per coordinate class, so /// every world is posed differently and every joint turned. pose_step: f32 = 0.05, /// The constraint check: the margin each ranged joint of the humanoid's is given, and the inertia the rows' /// softness is measured against - MuJoCo's default, as Geno is trained with (`robot_geno.physicsOptions`). limit_margin: f32 = 0.05, constraint_inertia: z.robot.ConstraintInertia = .reference_pose, }; /// Where the checks stand. const Phase = enum { /// The browser is compiling the device's kernels, in the background; the page draws how far it has come. preparing, /// The step and the requests are still to be submitted. submit, /// Submitted; collecting whatever has arrived, once a frame. collecting, /// Every check collected and compared. done, }; const State = struct { /// The allocator `init` was given, kept because the checks' requests need one for the twin's snapshots and a /// frame's callback receives none. The state owns everything allocated from it, freed in `deinit`. gpa: Allocator, settings: Settings, font: z.Font, geno: z.robot_mjcf.Imported, device_sim: Sim, twin_sim: Sim, /// A whole `world_u` arena of the poison word, uploaded before the step. poisoned_world_u: []u32, phase: Phase = .preparing, /// When the page's code started and when every pipeline was ready, on the host's clock, in milliseconds - in a /// browser that clock counts from the page's load. started_ms: f64, pipelines_ready_ms: ?f64 = null, /// The pipelines ready and to make, both device simulators' together, while the browser compiles them. pipelines_ready: u32 = 0, pipelines_total: u32 = 0, /// Whether the constraint check's device simulator has been asked for - made, or refused. constraint_sim_asked: bool = false, /// The three kernels the browser took longest over, the longest first; an empty name where there is none. slowest_kernels: [3]Pipe.PipelineMaking = @splat(.{ .kernel = "", .milliseconds = 0 }), /// Frames between the requests and the last copy arriving. frames_waited: u32 = 0, // The overflow check. overflow_device_request: ?Pipe.RangeRequest(.world_u) = null, overflow_twin_request: ?Pipe.RangeRequest(.world_u) = null, overflow_device_words: []u32, overflow_twin_words: []u32, overflow_done: bool = false, /// What the overflow check found: words not zero on the device, and words where device and twin differ. nonzero_device_words: u32 = 0, differing_words: u32 = 0, // The position stage's check: the comparison while its copies are on their way, then what it found. stage_comparison: ?robotgpu_host.StepComparison = null, stage_verdict: ?robotgpu_host.StepVerdict = null, /// The floor slots holding a contact on the twin after its step - so the page shows that the floor's arrays it /// compared held contacts, not empty slots. floor_contacts: u32 = 0, /// The constraint check's rows that are the floor's contacts', on the twin - so the page shows that they were among /// the rows compared. contact_rows: u32 = 0, // The constraint check: MuJoCo's humanoid, its hinges ranged - Geno's joints are balls, which take no range. humanoid: z.robot_mjcf.Imported, /// The device's workgroup memory, in bytes - what Newton's working set must fit in. workgroup_storage_bytes: u32, /// The constraint check's Sims, made once the step checks' requests are made: every twin works in the module's own /// arrays (`Sim.initTwin`), and the step checks' twin has snapshotted what they compare by then. constraint_device_sim: ?Sim = null, constraint_twin_sim: ?Sim = null, constraint_comparison: ?robotgpu_host.ConstraintComparison = null, constraint_verdict: ?robotgpu_host.ConstraintVerdict = null, /// Whether the device was refused for the constraint check: its workgroup memory too small for Newton. constraint_refused: bool = false, }; /// Every kernel of robotgpu's step program with its WGSL, which the build translates and embeds as `<kernel>_wgsl` - /// walked from the program, so the page dispatches exactly the kernels a step runs, in its order. fn kernelTable() [robotgpu.step_program.len]Pipe.KernelWgsl { var table: [robotgpu.step_program.len]Pipe.KernelWgsl = undefined; inline for (robotgpu.step_program, 0..) |dispatch, index| { table[index] = .{ .name = dispatch.kernel, .wgsl = @embedFile(dispatch.kernel ++ "_wgsl") }; } return table; } /// Every kernel of robotgpu's, the step program's then the constraint program's, with its WGSL - the constraint check /// runs the step up to the free acceleration, then the rows, their projection and Newton. fn allKernelTable() [robotgpu.kernels.len]Pipe.KernelWgsl { var table: [robotgpu.kernels.len]Pipe.KernelWgsl = undefined; inline for (robotgpu.kernels, 0..) |name, index| { table[index] = .{ .name = name, .wgsl = @embedFile(name ++ "_wgsl") }; } return table; } fn initState(gpa: Allocator, f: *z.Frame, s: *State) !void { const started_ms: f64 = z.monotonicMilliseconds(); const settings: Settings = .{}; const font: z.Font = try z.loadFont(f, gpa, atkinson_mono_ttf, 24); var geno: z.robot_mjcf.Imported = try z.robot_mjcf.importSource(gpa, z.robot_geno_model, .{}); errdefer geno.deinit(); // Stepped without its constraints: this check measures the smooth step against the twin, and the floor it is // given is for its contacts' slots alone - with the constraints disabled, no row is made. geno.model.opt.disable_constraints = true; // Every kernel of the step program, with its WGSL (`kernelTable`). const kernels: [robotgpu.step_program.len]Pipe.KernelWgsl = comptime kernelTable(); // Made in the background: the browser compiles the kernels off the page's thread, and the page says how far it // has come until they are ready (`Phase.preparing`). const world_count: u32 = settings.world_count; var device_sim: Sim = try .initGpuInBackground(gpa, f.gpu.device, f.gpu.queue, &kernels, &geno.model, world_count); errdefer device_sim.deinit(); var twin_sim: Sim = try .initTwin(gpa, &geno.model, settings.world_count); errdefer twin_sim.deinit(); // A floor at the middle world's root height. Each world's root stands `pose_step x 3` above the last's (its z, the // free root's third coordinate - `worldPoseCoordinate`), so the worlds below the middle are deep in the floor, // every geom touching, the middle world's legs reach under it and the worlds above are clear: filled slots and // empty ones, among the step's compared arrays. const middle_world: f32 = @floatFromInt(settings.world_count / 2 + 1); const floor_height: f32 = geno.model.reference_joint_positions[2] + settings.pose_step * 3.0 * middle_world; const ground: z.robot.Floor = .{ .plane = .{ .point = .{ 0, 0, floor_height, 0 }, .normal = .{ 0, 0, 1, 0 } } }; try device_sim.setFloor(ground); try twin_sim.setFloor(ground); const world_u_length: usize = @typeInfo(@FieldType(robotgpu.Buffers, "world_u")).array.len; const poisoned_world_u: []u32 = try gpa.alloc(u32, world_u_length); errdefer gpa.free(poisoned_world_u); @memset(poisoned_world_u, settings.poison); const word_count: u32 = device_sim.overflowWordCount(); const overflow_device_words: []u32 = try gpa.alloc(u32, word_count); errdefer gpa.free(overflow_device_words); const overflow_twin_words: []u32 = try gpa.alloc(u32, word_count); errdefer gpa.free(overflow_twin_words); var humanoid: z.robot_mjcf.Imported = try z.robot_mjcf.importSource(gpa, z.robot_humanoid_model, .{}); errdefer humanoid.deinit(); // No floor is set, so its rows are its joint limits': the step makes them, projects them and solves them. humanoid.model.opt.constraint_inertia = settings.constraint_inertia; for (humanoid.model.joint_range, humanoid.model.joint_limit_margin) |range, *margin| { if (range != null) { margin.* = settings.limit_margin; } } s.* = .{ .gpa = gpa, .settings = settings, .started_ms = started_ms, .font = font, .geno = geno, .device_sim = device_sim, .twin_sim = twin_sim, .poisoned_world_u = poisoned_world_u, .overflow_device_words = overflow_device_words, .overflow_twin_words = overflow_twin_words, .humanoid = humanoid, .workgroup_storage_bytes = z.wgpu.workgroupStorageLimit(f.gpu.device), }; } fn deinit(gpa: Allocator, s: *State) void { if (s.overflow_device_request) |*pending| { pending.discard(); } if (s.overflow_twin_request) |*pending| { pending.discard(); } if (s.stage_comparison) |*pending| { pending.deinit(gpa); } if (s.constraint_comparison) |*pending| { pending.deinit(gpa); } if (s.constraint_twin_sim) |*sim| { sim.deinit(); } if (s.constraint_device_sim) |*sim| { sim.deinit(); } s.humanoid.deinit(); gpa.free(s.overflow_twin_words); gpa.free(s.overflow_device_words); gpa.free(s.poisoned_world_u); s.twin_sim.deinit(); s.device_sim.deinit(); s.geno.deinit(); } /// Coordinate `coordinate` of world `world`'s pose: the reference pose moved by an amount that grows with the world /// and cycles with the coordinate, so no two worlds are posed alike. fn worldPoseCoordinate(s: *const State, world: u32, coordinate: u32) f32 { const world_factor: f32 = @floatFromInt(world + 1); const coordinate_factor: f32 = @floatFromInt(coordinate % 7 + 1); return s.geno.model.reference_joint_positions[coordinate] + s.settings.pose_step * coordinate_factor * world_factor; } /// Dof `dof`'s rate in world `world` - its joint velocity - an amount that cycles with the dof and grows with the /// world, so every world moves differently. fn worldRate(s: *const State, world: u32, dof: u32) f32 { const world_factor: f32 = @floatFromInt(world % 4 + 1); const dof_factor: f32 = @floatFromInt(dof % 7 + 1); return s.settings.pose_step * dof_factor * world_factor; } /// Actuator `actuator`'s control in world `world` - an amount that changes sign and size with the actuator and grows /// with the world, so every world drives its actuators differently. fn worldControl(s: *const State, world: u32, actuator: u32) f32 { const world_factor: f32 = @floatFromInt(world % 5 + 1); const actuator_factor: f32 = @floatFromInt(@as(i32, @intCast(actuator % 7)) - 3); return s.settings.pose_step * actuator_factor * world_factor; } /// Dof `dof`'s applied force in world `world` - a force from outside the model, as a world's input - an amount that /// grows with the world and cycles with the dof, so no two worlds are pushed alike. fn worldForce(s: *const State, world: u32, dof: u32) f32 { const world_factor: f32 = @floatFromInt(world + 1); const dof_factor: f32 = @floatFromInt(dof % 5 + 1); return s.settings.pose_step * dof_factor * world_factor; } /// The floor slots of `twin` holding a contact, over every world - read from the twin's arrays, this process's memory. fn countFloorContacts(twin: *const Sim) u32 { const filled: robotgpu.WorldArray(.world_u, .floor_slots) = twin.layout.world_u.floor_slot_filled; var contacts: u32 = 0; var world: u32 = 0; while (world < twin.counts.world_count) : (world += 1) { var slot: u32 = 0; while (slot < twin.counts.floor_slot_count) : (slot += 1) { contacts += filled.load(world, slot); } } return contacts; } /// Both Sims: `world_u` poisoned, every world posed, one step submitted; the overflow words and every pose array /// requested. fn submitChecks(s: *State) !void { const model: *const z.robot.Model = &s.geno.model; const coordinates: []f32 = try s.gpa.alloc(f32, model.coordinate_count); defer s.gpa.free(coordinates); const forces: []f32 = try s.gpa.alloc(f32, model.dof_count); defer s.gpa.free(forces); const rates: []f32 = try s.gpa.alloc(f32, model.dof_count); defer s.gpa.free(rates); const controls: []f32 = try s.gpa.alloc(f32, model.actuator_count); defer s.gpa.free(controls); const sims = [2]*Sim{ &s.device_sim, &s.twin_sim }; for (sims) |sim| { sim.pipe.upload(.world_u, s.poisoned_world_u); var world: u32 = 0; while (world < s.settings.world_count) : (world += 1) { for (coordinates, 0..) |*coordinate, index| { coordinate.* = worldPoseCoordinate(s, world, @intCast(index)); } sim.uploadWorldPositions(world, coordinates); for (forces, 0..) |*force, dof| { force.* = worldForce(s, world, @intCast(dof)); } sim.uploadWorldArray("applied_joint_forces", world, forces); for (rates, 0..) |*rate, dof| { rate.* = worldRate(s, world, @intCast(dof)); } sim.uploadWorldArray("joint_velocities", world, rates); for (controls, 0..) |*control, actuator| { control.* = worldControl(s, world, @intCast(actuator)); } sim.uploadWorldArray("controls", world, controls); } sim.submitStep(); } s.overflow_device_request = try s.device_sim.requestOverflow(s.gpa); s.overflow_twin_request = try s.twin_sim.requestOverflow(s.gpa); s.stage_comparison = try robotgpu_host.StepComparison.request(s.gpa, &s.device_sim, &s.twin_sim); // Counted now, from the twin's own arrays: the twin has stepped, and the constraint check's twin, which shares // them, has not run yet. s.floor_contacts = countFloorContacts(&s.twin_sim); } /// THE CONSTRAINT CHECK's SIMULATOR ON THE DEVICE, asked for while the step check's kernels are still compiling, so the /// browser compiles both sets together - or refused, if the device's workgroup memory cannot hold Newton's working /// set. It runs every kernel of robotgpu's, not the step's alone. fn makeConstraintDeviceSim(f: *z.Frame, s: *State) !void { const model: *const z.robot.Model = &s.humanoid.model; const kernels: [robotgpu.kernels.len]Pipe.KernelWgsl = comptime allKernelTable(); const world_count: u32 = s.settings.world_count; const device: z.wgpu.DeviceHandle = f.gpu.device; const queue: z.wgpu.QueueHandle = f.gpu.queue; s.constraint_device_sim = Sim.initGpuInBackground(s.gpa, device, queue, &kernels, model, world_count) catch |err| { if (err == error.WorkgroupMemoryTooSmall) { s.constraint_refused = true; return; } return err; }; } /// THE THREE KERNELS THE BROWSER TOOK LONGEST OVER, kept longest first. A kernel both simulators run is compiled once /// and found again by the second, so each kernel counts at the longer of its two makings. fn noteSlowestKernels(s: *State) void { var makings: [robotgpu.kernels.len]Pipe.PipelineMaking = undefined; var making_count: usize = 0; if (s.constraint_device_sim) |*constraint_sim| { making_count = constraint_sim.pipe.pipelineMakings(&makings); } var step_makings: [robotgpu.step_program.len]Pipe.PipelineMaking = undefined; const step_count: usize = s.device_sim.pipe.pipelineMakings(&step_makings); for (step_makings[0..step_count]) |step_making| { // The step's kernel among the constraint simulator's, if that simulator was made. const twice_made: ?*Pipe.PipelineMaking = for (makings[0..making_count]) |*making| { if (eql(u8, making.kernel, step_making.kernel)) { break making; } } else null; if (twice_made) |making| { making.milliseconds = @max(making.milliseconds, step_making.milliseconds); } else { makings[making_count] = step_making; making_count += 1; } } for (&s.slowest_kernels) |*slowest| { // The longest not yet taken; taken, it is struck out. var longest: ?usize = null; for (makings[0..making_count], 0..) |making, index| { const is_longer: bool = if (longest) |so_far| making.milliseconds > makings[so_far].milliseconds else true; if (making.milliseconds > 0 and is_longer) { longest = index; } } const taken: usize = longest orelse break; slowest.* = makings[taken]; makings[taken].milliseconds = 0; } } /// The constraint check's twin made beside its device simulator (`makeConstraintDeviceSim`), and both submitted /// through the constraint program from the humanoid's worlds posed around their limits; every array it compares /// requested. Nothing, if the device was refused. fn submitConstraintCheck(s: *State) !void { const model: *const z.robot.Model = &s.humanoid.model; const world_count: u32 = s.settings.world_count; if (s.constraint_refused) { return; } s.constraint_twin_sim = try .initTwin(s.gpa, model, world_count); const device_sim: *Sim = &s.constraint_device_sim.?; const twin_sim: *Sim = &s.constraint_twin_sim.?; const coordinates: []f32 = try s.gpa.alloc(f32, model.coordinate_count); defer s.gpa.free(coordinates); const rates: []f32 = try s.gpa.alloc(f32, model.dof_count); defer s.gpa.free(rates); // A floor 2 cm above the lowest point of the first world's pose: its lowest geoms in it, and the other worlds, // posed apart, some deeper and some clear - the floor's contacts' rows beside the limits'. robotgpu_host.poseAroundLimits(model, 0, coordinates, rates); const ground: z.robot.Floor = try robotgpu_host.floorUnderLowestPoint(s.gpa, model, coordinates, 0.02); const sims = [2]*Sim{ device_sim, twin_sim }; for (sims) |sim| { try sim.setFloor(ground); var world: u32 = 0; while (world < world_count) : (world += 1) { robotgpu_host.poseAroundLimits(model, world, coordinates, rates); sim.uploadWorldPositions(world, coordinates); sim.uploadWorldArray("joint_velocities", world, rates); } sim.submitStep(); } s.constraint_comparison = try robotgpu_host.ConstraintComparison.request(s.gpa, device_sim, twin_sim); // Counted now, from the twin's arrays, which the comparison has requested and nothing has changed since. s.contact_rows = robotgpu_host.countRowsOfKind(twin_sim, .contact); } /// The constraint program's arrays, collected as they arrive; once all have, the verdict kept and the buffers freed. fn collectConstraintCheck(s: *State) void { const comparison: *robotgpu_host.ConstraintComparison = &(s.constraint_comparison orelse return); if (comparison.collect()) { s.constraint_verdict = comparison.verdict; comparison.deinit(s.gpa); s.constraint_comparison = null; } } /// The overflow words, once both have arrived, compared world by world. fn collectOverflowCheck(s: *State) void { if (s.overflow_twin_request) |*pending| { if (pending.collect(s.overflow_twin_words)) { s.overflow_twin_request = null; } } if (s.overflow_device_request) |*pending| { if (pending.collect(s.overflow_device_words)) { s.overflow_device_request = null; } } const both_arrived: bool = s.overflow_twin_request == null and s.overflow_device_request == null; if (!both_arrived) { return; } var world: u32 = 0; while (world < s.settings.world_count) : (world += 1) { const device_word: u32 = s.device_sim.overflowOf(s.overflow_device_words, world); const twin_word: u32 = s.twin_sim.overflowOf(s.overflow_twin_words, world); s.nonzero_device_words += @intFromBool(device_word != 0); s.differing_words += @intFromBool(device_word != twin_word); } s.overflow_done = true; } /// The position stage's arrays, collected as they arrive; once all have, the comparison's verdict kept and its /// buffers freed. fn collectStageCheck(s: *State) void { const comparison: *robotgpu_host.StepComparison = &(s.stage_comparison orelse return); if (comparison.collect()) { s.stage_verdict = comparison.verdict; comparison.deinit(s.gpa); s.stage_comparison = null; } } fn update(f: *z.Frame, s: *State) void { switch (s.phase) { .preparing => { // The constraint check's device simulator is asked for first, so both sets of kernels compile together. if (!s.constraint_sim_asked) { s.constraint_sim_asked = true; makeConstraintDeviceSim(f, s) catch |err| { std.log.err("robotgpu_lab: the constraint check's simulator failed: {s}", .{@errorName(err)}); s.phase = .done; return; }; } var progress: Pipe.PipelineProgress = s.device_sim.pipe.pipelineProgress(); if (s.constraint_device_sim) |*constraint_sim| { const constraint_progress: Pipe.PipelineProgress = constraint_sim.pipe.pipelineProgress(); progress.ready += constraint_progress.ready; progress.total += constraint_progress.total; } s.pipelines_ready = progress.ready; s.pipelines_total = progress.total; if (progress.isComplete()) { s.pipelines_ready_ms = z.monotonicMilliseconds(); noteSlowestKernels(s); s.phase = .submit; } }, .submit => { submitChecks(s) catch |err| { std.log.err("robotgpu_lab: the checks' requests failed: {s}", .{@errorName(err)}); s.phase = .done; return; }; submitConstraintCheck(s) catch |err| { std.log.err("robotgpu_lab: the constraint check's requests failed: {s}", .{@errorName(err)}); s.phase = .done; return; }; s.phase = .collecting; }, .collecting => { s.frames_waited += 1; if (!s.overflow_done) { collectOverflowCheck(s); } collectStageCheck(s); collectConstraintCheck(s); const constraints_done: bool = s.constraint_verdict != null or s.constraint_refused; if (s.overflow_done and s.stage_verdict != null and constraints_done) { s.phase = .done; } }, .done => {}, } z.clearViewport(f, z.colors.slate_900); // Short lines, each a thing to read, so the page fits a phone's narrow screen as well as a desktop's. const title_color: Color = z.colors.slate_100; const text_color: Color = z.colors.slate_300; f.gl.text(.{ 16, 16 }, "robotgpu lab", .{ .size = 22, .color = title_color, .font = &s.font }); f.gl.textf(.{ 16, 48 }, "Geno, {d} worlds, on the GPU and on the CPU twin", .{ s.settings.world_count, }, .{ .size = 16, .color = text_color, .font = &s.font }); const frame_word: []const u8 = if (s.frames_waited == 1) "frame" else "frames"; // The overflow check. f.gl.text(.{ 16, 96 }, "Overflow words cleared by a step", .{ .size = 16, .color = title_color, .font = &s.font }); if (s.overflow_done) { const agree: bool = s.nonzero_device_words == 0 and s.differing_words == 0; const verdict_color: Color = if (agree) z.colors.emerald_400 else z.colors.red_400; if (agree) { f.gl.textf(.{ 16, 124 }, "AGREE - all {d} worlds zero on both", .{s.settings.world_count}, .{ .size = 16, .color = verdict_color, .font = &s.font, }); } else { f.gl.textf(.{ 16, 124 }, "DIFFER - {d} device words not zero,", .{s.nonzero_device_words}, .{ .size = 16, .color = verdict_color, .font = &s.font, }); f.gl.textf(.{ 16, 152 }, "{d} unlike the twin's", .{s.differing_words}, .{ .size = 16, .color = verdict_color, .font = &s.font, }); } } else { f.gl.textf(.{ 16, 124 }, "checking ({d} {s})", .{ s.frames_waited, frame_word }, .{ .size = 16, .color = text_color, .font = &s.font, }); } // The pose check. f.gl.text(.{ 16, 200 }, "The step, device against twin", .{ .size = 16, .color = title_color, .font = &s.font, }); // Every line short enough for a phone held upright - about 48 characters at this size. if (s.stage_verdict) |verdict| { const agree: bool = verdict.agrees(); const verdict_word: []const u8 = if (agree) "AGREE" else "DIFFER"; const verdict_color: Color = if (agree) z.colors.emerald_400 else z.colors.red_400; f.gl.textf(.{ 16, 228 }, "{s} - largest gap {d:.2} epsilons", .{ verdict_word, verdict.worst_gap_epsilons, }, .{ .size = 16, .color = verdict_color, .font = &s.font }); f.gl.textf(.{ 16, 256 }, "in {s}, its bar {d:.0}", .{ verdict.worst_array, verdict.worst_bar_epsilons, }, .{ .size = 14, .color = text_color, .font = &s.font }); f.gl.textf(.{ 16, 280 }, "the floor's {d} contacts among the arrays", .{s.floor_contacts}, .{ .size = 14, .color = text_color, .font = &s.font, }); } else { f.gl.textf(.{ 16, 228 }, "checking ({d} {s})", .{ s.frames_waited, frame_word }, .{ .size = 16, .color = text_color, .font = &s.font, }); } // The constraint check. f.gl.text(.{ 16, 328 }, "The humanoid's constraints, device against twin", .{ .size = 16, .color = title_color, .font = &s.font, }); if (s.constraint_refused) { f.gl.textf(.{ 16, 356 }, "REFUSED - {d} bytes of workgroup memory", .{s.workgroup_storage_bytes}, .{ .size = 16, .color = z.colors.red_400, .font = &s.font, }); } else if (s.constraint_verdict) |verdict| { const agree: bool = verdict.agrees(); const verdict_word: []const u8 = if (agree) "AGREE" else "DIFFER"; const verdict_color: Color = if (agree) z.colors.emerald_400 else z.colors.red_400; f.gl.textf(.{ 16, 356 }, "{s} - {d} rows, {d} the floor's", .{ verdict_word, verdict.rows_compared, s.contact_rows, }, .{ .size = 16, .color = verdict_color, .font = &s.font, }); // The rows' integers must be the twin's exactly. Newton's rounds may differ - its stops are thresholds - so // they are shown, not judged. const integers_word: []const u8 = if (verdict.integers_agree) "the rows' integers are the twin's" else "THE ROWS' INTEGERS ARE NOT THE TWIN'S";
